chapter: Opinions on singers, promotion and originality
title: Making albums in hours: 36 by Ella
summary: Albums once took three sessions or less; Edison made a 36-tune album with Ella Fitzgerald in three hours.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: Also the fact is that when you used to make albums, at the most you could have three sessions. These people will take three weeks to make an album.
Oh, some of it -- they gave him a year to make an album.

Stevie Wonder. You know, they gave him one year to make an album. And we used to make -- Art Tatum used to make five and six in one day. I made an album of 36 tunes in one day with Ella Fitzgerald. That's that album called '36 by Ella.'
Made it in three hours. In three hours.

Well, it is ridiculous. But what I was interested in listening to Leonard's daughter was, you could sort of hear the different influences that were there. So it does not sort of come out -- it's sort of lacking in integrity.
